CFML Language Reference: Functions

ListInsertAt

Returns a copy of a list with a new element inserted before the element at the given position. The new element takes that position and the elements after it move one place to the right.

Category

List functions

Syntax

ListInsertAt(list, position, value [, delimiters ])

Parameters

list
The list to change.
position
Where to insert, from 1 to ListLen(list).
value
The element to insert.
delimiters
Optional. The delimiter characters of the list; the default is a comma. The first character is placed after the new element.

Returns

The new list.

Usage

The position must be an existing element, so ListInsertAt cannot add to the end of a list or to an empty list; use ListAppend for that.

Example

Opens the example in a new window. The example runs on this server, so it only works when you browse from the server itself (127.0.0.1).
<CFSET Lineup = "Monday,Tuesday,Thursday,Friday">
<CFSET Lineup = ListInsertAt(Lineup, 3, "Wednesday")>
<CFSET Lineup = ListInsertAt(Lineup, 1, "Sunday")>
<CFSET Lineup = ListAppend(Lineup, "Saturday")>
<OL>
<CFLOOP INDEX="Day" LIST="#Lineup#">
  <CFOUTPUT><LI>#Day#</CFOUTPUT>
</CFLOOP>
</OL>

See also

ListAppend, ListPrepend, ListSetAt, ListDeleteAt, ArrayInsertAt
